title: Page 4
content_zh:
“不过说也怪，瞧龙爷相貌，他小时候应该是个标致的娃儿，这么优秀俊俏能力又强的孩子，竟狠得下心不要，真不知道龙爷他娘在想些什么……要换作是我啊……”
“你一个人在那儿嘀咕什么？”
枣儿被身后传来的声音吓了一跳，转头，看见担柴的金河叔跟他儿子金元一块儿站在园子口，她赶忙起身。
“早啊，金河叔。”
金河叔指指堆在门口的柴堆。“你爹说家里没了柴薪，要我担些过来。”
石家虽然没钱，可买柴薪的银子石老庐从不省下，枣儿提过好几次她可以上山捡柴，可石老庐就是舍不得见她背着沉重的柴薪，独自来回野林。
“我就去取钱。”抱起箕箩，枣儿身一转就要紧家门，金河叔却早一步拉住她。
“等一等枣儿，金河叔有话问你。”
枣儿就这样被金河叔拉到一旁。
“上回金河叔跟你提过的事，你考虑得怎样？”
枣儿一瞅金河叔，再一看远处双颊赤红的金元，一脸尴尬。“这种事……应该要去先问我爹吧……”
金河叔不放弃。“我昨儿来问过了，你爹说他没意见，只要你同意就好。”
金河叔问的是枣儿的亲事。自几月前枣儿及笄，金河叔便来过好多回，问她要不要嫁来他们金家。枣儿一直拿她爹当借口，以为她爹早出晚归，金河叔不容易遇上，怎知这一回她爹腰伤在家休养，就正好被他逮上。
低垂着头的枣儿一瞄金元，说来她跟他还是自小就认识的青梅竹马，而且她也不算讨厌他，但她就是——还不想嫁嘛！
“我不知该怎么说了……”枣儿摇了摇头。“金河叔又不是不知我爹摔着腰了，光想他的腰不知什么时候会好，我……就没有心思想旁的事。”
“这等大事怎么可以不想？”金河叔回嘴，然后一瞧枣儿脸色，口气又软了下来。“不然这样好了，这趟柴火钱甭拿了，你留着帮你爹买点肥的添添油水。”
“不行！”
枣儿哪敢收这礼，嘴一喊马上冲进房取了钱来，可金家人也没那么容易打发，才一眨眼，一老一少早走得不见人影。
枣儿猛一跺脚，回头，瞧见家门口还挂了一个小包，
用早膳时石老庐瞧见枣儿垮着脸不高兴，忍不住问：“怎么了？”

枣儿白他一眼。“还不都是您，干么要跟金河叔讲那种话！”
“你说跟金元成亲那件事？”石老庐挟了块腌瓜进嘴。“我觉得那孩子不错啊，你不喜欢？”
不喜欢！
几个字冒失地从她脑里钻了出来，直白到连她自己也吓了一跳。她这才知道，原来她并不喜欢金元哥。
见女儿不说话，石老庐叹口气。“爹是不晓得你心里是怎么看待金元，但你跟金元，称得上是门当户对。”
意思是她这个穷人家姑娘，有个担柴的汉子喜欢，就该额手称庆了。
但枣儿脑子却浮现龙焱俊朗的眉眼。
照爹说法，龙爷与她，不就是门不当户不对，毫无希望的一对，她的心一下跌至谷底。
“我吃饱了。”她抓起碗筷躲入灶间，几乎是同一时间她做出决定，她要学割烹，顾不了爹的交代了，她只想把握每一个能待在龙焱身边的日子。
即使，只有短短十数日。
小厮拍拍门。“龙爷，该起身了。”
一听见声音，仍卧在床上的龙焱倏地张开双眼。
“知道了。”说完话，他摸摸胸口，一股浊气梗在喉口，起身，感觉头眩了眩，暗叫声糟，定是昨夜不小心染了风寒。
昨儿入夜，他同账房一块检视烹“菊花锅子”需用上的白菊花苗。“菊花锅子”是“一条龙”一道名馔，也就是将白菊花去蕊入锅一道滚煮，再佐以鱼片、腰片、山鸡等一块涮煮，其汤一清似水，但进肚又菊香沁心，堪称绝品。
“一条龙”里用的白菊花全是饭庄自种，所以入夏不久，花贩子总会运来一丛丛菊花苗，供龙焱挑选。
昨夜跟账房说话时就觉喉头干痒，但他嫌麻烦，没喊人帮他准备姜汤，这下可好了。龙焱来得及。
正午，“一条龙”里外一样忙碌，龙焱仍旧在灶房里游走审视，丝毫不懈怠。许是热气过炙，得空时他一走出灶房，便觉手脚虚软，他赶忙强自忍耐，扶栏站稳。
在他喘气调息当时，一伙底下人自他身旁经过，每个人都张口喊了一声“龙爷”，就是没有人发觉他神色有异，只当他在欣赏园景。
只有一个人察觉有异。
枣儿抱了一迭盘自龙焱身旁经过，走没两步，她突然停步回头瞅他。

中药材的味道？还是从龙爷身上传来的？
龙焱没发现身后的枣儿，等气息稍稳，他马上回他跨院休息。以为睡一会儿，他下午人就舒服了。
可风寒却没他想的好收拾，一觉乍起，他整颗头嗡嗡直鸣，喉咙也疼到不行，就算多服了几颗药丸，一样不见好转。
正在考虑晚上要早点休息，结果账房却突然跑来拍门。
“龙爷，您在里边吗？”
“什么事？”龙焱开门，慵懒一睇。
账房拍拍胸顺了口气。“刚才小的在前厅招呼，忽然来了两位爷，我正觉得其中一位眼熟，刚好听见他说溜了嘴，您知道他喊旁边人什么？”
龙焱皱眉。
账房接着道：“他喊‘万岁爷’！”
龙焱一惊。“你没听错？”
“千真万确！”账房对自己眼力耳力很有自信。“小的一路走来，终于让小的想起那名眼熟的客人是谁，他前阵子才来过，是醇亲王爷。”
那没错了。龙焱强打起精神。“要老崔石草他们几个过来取‘牡丹’盘，我就到灶边候着。”他说什么也要让醇亲王爷跟万岁爷吃得宾主尽欢。
“小的就去。”
账房一走，龙焱要小厮帮他取件干净袍子，出门那时，一阵夜风拂来，他忍不住打了两个喷嚏，鼻子一塞，就连经过开得正艳的藤萝，也丝毫嗅不着花香。
早不病晚不病，竟挑这节骨眼染风寒！龙焱暗自着恼。他重吐了口气又喝了一大杯温水，现只能靠平素养成的技艺，硬着头皮顶过去了。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
回头，正好见王二枣儿开头还以为是自己鼻子有问题，可越闻越觉得不对。
填在鸡里的云腿馊了，没人闻到吗？
王二摆好盘，端起大喊：“鸡包翅上桌。”
“等等——”枣儿忙奔过去。“不能上桌！”

“你这家伙怎么搞的！”王二冲着枣儿大骂：“外头客人等着，你却在这儿给我捣乱，还不滚开！”
“我不是在捣乱！”枣儿左挡右挡就是不让“鸡包翅”出门。“您听我解释，这道菜，真的不能上桌……”
“你这家伙……”
龙焱听见争执，神情不悦地走了过来。“在闹什么？”
“云腿有问题！”枣儿冲着龙焱大喊。
“你才有问题！”
王二气炸，脚一抬用力踹向枣儿膝盖。
枣儿“唉呦”一声摔向石灶，眼看就要磕着脑袋，好在龙焱及时抓住她。
“龙爷！”枣儿捂着疼痛不已的右膝边说：“那‘鸡包翅’真的不能上桌，我可以拿性命担保，里边用的云腿已经馊了……”
content_en:
"But it's strange. Looking at Mr. Long's appearance, he should have been a handsome boy when he was a child. Such an outstanding, handsome and capable child is so cruel that he is so determined to give up. I really don't know what Mr. Long is thinking... If it were me..."
"What are you mumbling about there alone?"
Zao'er was startled by the sound coming from behind. She turned around and saw Uncle Jin He, who was carrying firewood, standing at the entrance of the garden with his son Jin Yuan. She quickly got up.
"Good morning, Uncle Jinhe."
Uncle Jinhe pointed to the pile of firewood piled at the door. "Your father said that we ran out of firewood and asked me to carry some."
Although the Shi family had no money, Shi Laolu never spared money to buy firewood. Zaoer mentioned several times that she could go up the mountain to collect firewood, but Shi Laolu just couldn't bear to see her carrying a heavy load of firewood back and forth to the wild forest alone.
"I'm going to get the money." Picking up the basket, Zaoer turned around and was about to close the door, but Uncle Jinhe grabbed her earlier.
"Wait a minute Zaoer, Uncle Jinhe has something to ask you."
Zaoer was pulled aside by Uncle Jinhe.
"How do you think about what Uncle Jinhe mentioned to you last time?"
Zaoer glanced at Uncle Jinhe and then at Jin Yuan with red cheeks in the distance, with an embarrassed look on his face. "You should ask my dad first about this kind of thing..."
Uncle Jinhe never gives up. "I came to ask yesterday, and your father said he had no objection, as long as you agree."
Uncle Jinhe asked about Zaoer's marriage. Ever since Zao'er got married a few months ago, Uncle Jin He had visited her many times and asked her if she wanted to marry into their Jin family. Zao'er has always used her father as an excuse, thinking that her father leaves early and comes back late, so it is not easy for Uncle Jin He to meet him. How could she know that this time her father was recuperating at home due to a back injury, and he happened to catch him.
Zao'er, who lowered her head, glanced at Jin Yuan. She and he were childhood sweethearts who had known each other since childhood, and she didn't dislike him, but she just--she didn't want to get married yet!
"I don't know what to say..." Zaoer shook his head. "Uncle Jinhe doesn't know that my father broke his back. Just thinking about when his back will recover, I... don't have the mind to think about anything else."
"How can you not think about such a big thing?" Uncle Jinhe retorted, and then when he looked at Zaoer's face, his tone softened again. "Otherwise, that's fine. Don't take the firewood money for this trip. You can keep it to help your father buy some fat for extra fuel."
"No!"
How could Zaoer dare to accept this gift? She rushed into the room and took out the money as soon as she yelled, but the Jin family didn't get rid of it so easily. In the blink of an eye, the old man and the young man had already disappeared.
Zaoer stomped her feet, turned around, and saw a small bag hanging at the door of her house.
While having breakfast, Shi Laolu saw Zaoer's downcast face and was unhappy, so he couldn't help but ask, "What's wrong?"
Zaoer rolled her eyes at him. "It's not all you, why would you say that to Uncle Jin He!"
"What are you talking about about getting married to Jin Yuan?" Shi Laolu took a piece of pickled melon and put it into his mouth. "I think that kid is pretty good, don't you like it?"
Don't like it!
A few words popped out of her mind, so straightforward that even she was shocked. Only then did she realize that she didn't like Brother Jin Yuan.
Seeing that his daughter was silent, Shi Laolu sighed. "Dad, I don't know how you feel about Jin Yuan, but you and Jin Yuan are a perfect match."
It means that if she, a poor girl, likes a man who carries firewood, she should be proud of him.
But Long Yan's handsome features appeared in Zaoer's mind.
According to what her father said, Master Long and her were just a mismatched, hopeless couple. Her heart dropped to the bottom.
"I'm full." She grabbed the bowls and chopsticks and hid in the stove. She made the decision almost at the same time. She wanted to learn Kappo. She couldn't care about her father's instructions. She just wanted to seize every day she could stay with Long Yan.
Even if it is only a few days.
The boy patted the door. "Master Long, it's time to get up."
As soon as he heard the sound, Long Yan, who was still lying on the bed, opened his eyes suddenly.
"I know." After saying this, he touched his chest and felt a turbid air.When I stood up, I felt dizzy and screamed. I must have accidentally caught the wind and cold last night.
Last night at night, he and the accountant inspected the white chrysanthemum seedlings needed to cook the "chrysanthemum pot". "Chrysanthemum pot" is a famous "one-stop" dish, that is, white chrysanthemums are boiled in a pot with their pistils removed, and then cooked with fish fillets, kidney slices, pheasants, etc. The soup is as clear as water, but the fragrance of chrysanthemum is refreshing in the stomach, which is a masterpiece.
The white chrysanthemums used in "Yilong" are all grown by the restaurant, so soon after summer, flower dealers always bring clumps of chrysanthemum seedlings for Long Yan to choose from.
Last night when he was talking to the accountant, he felt his throat was dry and itchy, but he didn't think it was troublesome and didn't ask anyone to prepare ginger soup for him. Now it's better. Long Yan had enough time.
At noon, "Yilong" was equally busy inside and outside, and Long Yan was still walking around the kitchen inspecting it without slacking off at all. Maybe it was too hot. As soon as he walked out of the kitchen when he had time, he felt that his hands and feet were weak. He hurriedly forced himself to endure it and stood firm on the railing.
While he was catching his breath, a group of people passed by him, and everyone shouted "Lord Long", but no one noticed that he looked different, they just thought he was admiring the garden scenery.
Only one person noticed something different.
Zao'er passed by Long Yan with a bunch of dishes in her arms. After taking only two steps, she suddenly stopped and looked back at him.
The smell of Chinese medicinal materials? Or did it come from Lord Long?
Long Yan didn't notice Zao'er behind him. When his breath stabilized, he immediately went back to his hospital to rest. He thought that if he slept for a while, he would feel better in the afternoon.
But the wind and cold were not as easy to deal with as he thought. When he woke up, his whole head was buzzing and his throat was so painful. Even if he took a few more pills, it still didn't get better.
I was thinking about going to bed early in the evening, but the accountant suddenly came to knock on the door.
"Master Long, are you in there?"
"What's going on?" Long Yan opened the door and took a lazy look.
The cashier patted his chest and breathed a sigh of relief. "Just now, I was greeting you in the front hall, and suddenly two gentlemen came. I thought one of them looked familiar, and I happened to hear him say, "Do you know what he called the person next to him?"
Long Yan frowned.
The accountant continued: "He shouted 'Long Live Lord'!"
Long Yan was shocked. "Did you hear that correctly?"
"It's absolutely true!" The accountant was very confident in his eyesight and ears. "As I walked along, I finally remembered who the familiar guest was. He had just been here a while ago. He was Prince Chun."
That's right. Long Yanqiang cheered up. "If you ask Lao Cui Shicao and the others to come over and get the 'peony' plate, I'll wait by the stove." He said that he wanted Prince Chun and Lord Long live to eat to the fullest.
"Just go if you're young."
As soon as Long Yan left the accounting office, he asked the servant to pick up a clean robe for him. When he was leaving, a gust of night wind blew by, and he couldn't help but sneeze twice. His nose was stuffed up, and he couldn't smell the fragrance of flowers at all even when he passed by the blooming wisteria.
If you don't get sick early, you won't get sick later, but you pick this time to catch the wind and cold! Long Yan was secretly annoyed. He took a deep breath and drank a large glass of warm water. Now he could only rely on the skills he had developed in his daily life and endured it.

Looking back, I happened to see Wang Erzaoer. At first, he thought there was something wrong with his nose, but the more he smelled it, the more he felt something was wrong.
The cloud legs stuffed in the chicken are sour, does anyone smell it?
Wang Er placed the plate, picked it up and shouted: "Chicken wrapped wings are served."
"Wait a minute -" Zao'er hurried over. “Can’t serve!”
"What did you do!" Wang Er yelled at Zao'er: "The guests are waiting outside, but you are making trouble for me here, why don't you get out of here!"
"I'm not making trouble!" Zao'er blocked left and right just to prevent the "chicken with wings" from going out. "Listen to my explanation, this dish really cannot be served..."
"You guy..."
Long Yan heard the argument and came over with an unhappy expression. "What's the fuss about?"
"There's something wrong with Yun's legs!" Zao'er shouted at Long Yan.
"You're the one with the problem!"
Wang Er was furious and kicked his assHe lifted up and kicked Zaoer's knees hard.
Zao'er fell to Shi Zao with a "Oh!" and was about to knock her head. Fortunately, Long Yan caught her in time.
"Master Long!" Zao'er said, holding her painful right knee: "That 'chicken-wrapped wing' really can't be served. I can guarantee it with my life. The chicken legs used in it are already sour..."
